turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Khan from Hyderabad?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is she. Who is this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Inspector Vikram from the Cyber Crime Unit. We have intercepted a courier package containing illegal narcotics and several fake passports linked to your Aadhaar number.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What? That is impossible, I have not sent any parcel!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is why we are calling, but your identity is being used for money laundering. This is now a matter of digital arrest, so you must stay on this line and not tell anyone, or you will be picked up by local police immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Please, I am an old woman, I do not know anything about these things. What should I do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not panic, but you must cooperate to clear your name. I am transferring your case to our verification officer to see if you are a victim or a suspect.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Can I call my son to help me with this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Absolutely not, this is a confidential government operation and any leak will be seen as tampering with evidence. You will be arrested if you hang up.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am very scared now. Please tell me how to fix this.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To prove your innocence, you need to transfer eighty thousand rupees into a secure government verification account for a temporary security deposit.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Eighty thousand? I do not have that much money readily available.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You must arrange it through a friend or bank transfer right now, or I will have no choice but to issue the warrant for your arrest.
